selected_evidence.requirement: opsadmin user exists with the specified public key installed
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed opsadmin did not exist, created it, and installed the exact provided ed25519 key into authorized_keys with correct ownership/permissions (700/600).

selected_evidence.requirement: SSH requires key-based authentication (no password fallback)
selected_evidence.summary: Full sshd_config review shows PasswordAuthentication no / PubkeyAuthentication yes globally with no overriding Match blocks; config validated and ssh restarted; live SSH attempt without the private key was rejected with Permission denied (publickey) and no password prompt, and opsadmin's own password was locked (passwd -S shows L).
Captured boot_id f19de998-36cd-41ab-a353-935e77b5569d, ssh active, opsadmin present with correct key before restart.
Backgrounded shutdown -r now returned ACK_REBOOT_ISSUED immediately, before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity changed (proof of actual restart)
selected_evidence.summary: Node became unreachable (connection refused) immediately after reboot, then came back online with a new boot_id 4c125ee7-b91c-416a-9903-340be72bde23, differing from the pre-restart value.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services/data and continued key-only enforcement
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, ssh service active, opsadmin user/key intact, password still locked, sshd_config still enforces PasswordAuthentication no / PubkeyAuthentication yes, and a live SSH attempt without the private key was again rejected with publickey-only denial.
